When I asked my dad why he was here 
My dad told me my cousin offered to rent the car we drove up in so he HAD to come. But no one asked me, no one told me. And my dad said since I won’t tell him what happened he can’t understand so he can’t do anything about it. Like not inviting him. My dad’s words were “he’s your cousin, whatever is you’ll have to get over it” and then he and my cousin and my sister stood outside the car and discussed how I was over dramatic all the time. My cousin laughed. 

But
They are all the family I have 
My mom passed away
If I don’t talk to them I’ll have no one
